name: The Friend-ly Farm
tagline: DeVries Fruit and Veggie Roadside Stand / The Friend
description: In 60542 Gunnison Road, CO, The Friend-ly Farm raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a small farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
